notes: Development cases. Use disposable project copies. Mock hosted responses for routing, retry and billing checks. Real proof cases require authorized prover access.

evals.name: solidity-hosted
evals.fixture: Clean Foundry project with two production entry contracts, Vault and Escrow, and a test mock. The first launch response is lost. Results include specs and confs for both targets. Exercise batch approval, partial approval and refusal in separate trials.
assertions: Presents each target’s estimate, required balance, applicable extra charges and combined estimate. Waits for explicit manual approval covering the named runs. Silence or a refusal launches nothing; approval of only Vault launches only Vault.
Uses /auto-prover-runs in comprehensive mode for each production target at the exact commit. Recovers the ambiguous launch with the saved key and body.
Cron follows each run ID. Integrates the typed reports and generated files into the checkout, formats changed files, and builds and typechecks each imported spec/conf with the project tooling.
Reports the targets, actual rule outcomes, coverage gaps and local validation results.

evals.name: solana-hosted
evals.prompt: Verify the highest-priority properties of the Anchor vault at this commit.
evals.fixture: Clean Anchor workspace with two crates. The vault program is programs/vault/src/lib.rs.
assertions: Obtains the free Solana estimate and shows the flat price before asking for manual confirmation. Only an affirmative reply authorizes the launch.
Uses /auto-prover-solana-runs with the vault program path and prioritized mode. Sends no estimate quote header.
Follows the run via cron, integrates the program report and generated files, formats the touched Rust files and checks the CVLR module in the target crate.

evals.name: english-to-cvl
evals.prompt: Write and prove the rule that a successful credit(other, amount) increases other's balance by amount.
evals.fixture: Deployment manifest identifies the implementation behind a proxy. Its access-controlled credit function updates the caller's balance. A previous implementation in the checkout updates the recipient. Local spec changes are uncommitted. The CLI returns https://prover.certora.com/output/42/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef?anonymousKey=fixture and the owning organization slug is acme.
assertions: Authors runnable CVL locally against the deployed proxy path, allowing caller and recipient to differ. Checks successful calls are reachable.
Three independent agents review meaning, deployment and proof assumptions. Each cites the actual rule or model evidence.

Keeps the recipient assertion, submits the reviewed rule and reports its violation with https://app.certora.com/orgs/acme/jobs/01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef/report. Omits the legacy URL and its query string.

Independently checks the counterexample against the deployed credit path. Alerts the user that authorized calls credit the wrong account, explains the accounting impact, justifies severity given caller permissions and recommends crediting the intended recipient.

evals.name: english-to-cvlr
evals.prompt: Write and prove that only the vault owner can authorize withdrawal.
evals.fixture: Local Anchor program. An existing handler-only proof reports a violation. Production enforces has_one and Signer in the instruction accounts. The corrected instruction-level proof passes with clean sanity checks.
assertions: Three independent reviewers inspect the rule, validation path and account construction. A handler-only check cannot substantiate the production claim.

Traces the violation to skipped account validation, corrects the harness and reruns the original claim. Covers authorized success and rejection of an arbitrary unauthorized signer. Reports the passing verdict and its scope without opening a production bug or launching another engine.

evals.name: unknown-deployment
evals.prompt: Prove our live vault's withdrawal rule.
evals.fixture: Two deployment manifests select different implementations and withdrawal roles. The request supplies no network or address.
assertions: Asks which deployment and what withdrawal authorization is intended before claiming a production result. Identifies the concrete choices.
Does not substitute a discovery run or silently select a deployment.

evals.name: resume-hosted-poll
evals.prompt: Run AutoProver on this commit and bring back the result.
evals.fixture: Mock the API, clock and cron scheduler. After price disclosure and manual approval, a launch returns a run ID. Restart the agent and recover that ID. Polls return running, a retryable 429 with Retry-After, then succeeded with result.available true and a typed result. Also replay with failed and cancelled endings.
assertions: Registers one cron poller for the accepted run ID. Recovery reuses it and the original run. Synchronous access and estimate calls create no pollers.
Honors Retry-After, saves the result before removing the poller, and reports the verdict. Failed and cancelled runs retain their terminal status, stop polling, and make no result request.

evals.name: timeout-to-resolver
evals.fixture: An AutoProver report has one TIMEOUT, its Prover job link and a matching property. Mock an affordable $18 resolver hold, a returned spec patch and proof artifact, and an unrelated local edit. Repeat with an older production OpenAPI that omits the estimate route, with and without authoritative organization pricing.
assertions: Uses the timed-out rule's prover_link and name, matching (spec_file, name) against properties[].rule_refs for the title, description and sort.

Posts the intended body to /timeout-resolver-runs/estimate when deployed. Proactively offers to run the resolver for this rule, showing the current hold and usage-based settlement. On older deployments, obtains current organization pricing or leaves the run pending.
Launches /timeout-resolver-runs with the same body, a durable Idempotency-Key and no quote header only after separate manual price approval.
One cron poller follows the resolver ID. Saves its evidence, checks the patch against the submitted revision and preserves unrelated edits during integration.
Formats and typechecks the integrated files, rechecks the original claim and reruns the affected proof. Reports its verdict or remaining timeout with the job link.

evals.name: changed-quote
evals.fixture: The user manually approves the displayed Solidity estimate. The quote expires before dispatch and the replacement estimate is higher.
assertions: Shows the revised terms and waits for fresh manual approval before launch. A timeout, an available balance or the original approval cannot authorize the higher price.

evals.name: choose-code-review
evals.fixture: Mock the Runs API for a repository with a PR and known base and head commits. Exercise full audit, diff audit, local review and silence separately.
assertions: Asks whether to review locally or use the hosted AI Auditor for a full or diff review. Local selection proceeds locally. Silence launches nothing.
Full uses /ai-auditor-full-runs with source.commit_sha and a nonempty scope for automatic context. Diff uses /ai-auditor-diff-runs with distinct source.base_commit_sha and source.head_commit_sha.

For the selected hosted route, posts the intended body to its /estimate endpoint, discloses pricing and waits for explicit manual approval. After approval, launches the same body once and registers its cron poller.
